Mysteries.Title:
The First Glorious Mystery

Jesus rises from the dead.
Mysteries.SubTitle: Obedience

Meditation.text: Jesus is risen from the dead.
He appeared to the apostles and says: “Peace be with you.”
He then appeared to more than five hundred at one time.
If Christ is not risen, then our faith is useless.
Thomas declares: “Unless I see I will not believe.”
“Blessed are they who have not seen and have believed.”
“He who believes and is baptized will be saved.”
Faith is a gift of God.
“He who believes in Me will never die.”
“Lord, I do believe, help my unbelief.”

Mysteries.Title:
The Second Glorious Mystery

Jesus ascends to Heaven
Mysteries.SubTitle: Love Others

Meditation.text: Mary visits her elderly cousin Elizabeth.
Elizabeth is with child. His name is John.
She greets Mary: “Blessed are you because you believed.”
Mary herself is with Child, through the Holy Spirit.
She answers: “My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord.”
“His mercy reaches from age to age.”
Mary, the Mother of God, stays to help Elizabeth.
After three months Mary returns to her home in Nazareth.
Do good to all.
Be at peace with everyone.

Mysteries.Title:
The Third Glorious Mystery

Descent of the Holy Spirit
Mysteries.SubTitle: Poverty

Meditation.text: The Apostles and Mary were together in prayer.
A sound from heaven filled the whole house.
Suddenly tongues of fire rested on each of them.
They were filled with the Holy Spirit.
Men of every nation understood them in their own language.
They were strengthened to preach the Gospel without fear.
Peter declared: “God has made both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
You are children of God because of your faith in Jesus.
Love one another.
Love your enemies.

Mysteries.Title:
The Fourth Glorious Mystery

Mary is taken up into Heaven
Mysteries.SubTitle: Humility

Meditation.text: “You will not suffer your faithful one to undergo corruption.”
“You are the glory of Jerusalem. You are the splendid boast of our people.”
“Arise, My beloved, My beautiful one, and come.”
“You are all-beautiful... and there is no blemish in you.”
“The Queen takes her place at Your right hand.”
“Blessed are you, daughter... above all women on earth.”
“Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you.”
If we are likened to Christ in His death, so shall we be in His resurrection.
“I shall return to take you with Me.”
“God’s temple in heaven opened, and there was seen the ark of His covenant.”

Mysteries.Title:
The Fifth Glorious Mystery

Mary is Crowned QUEEN OF HEAVEN AND EARTH
Mysteries.SubTitle: Joy in Finding Jesus

Meditation.text: “A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun.”
“The moon was under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.”
“In the highest heavens did I dwell, my throne on a pillar of cloud”
“I am the mother of pure love”
“I am the mother of knowledge.”
“I am the mother of hope.”
Mary is Queen Mother of Him who “shall reign in the house of Jacob forever.”
“Those who seek Me find Me.”
“He who serves Me will never fail.”
“He who finds Me finds life.”
